budget.phase: before clone performance measurements and optimization
budget.measurement: Two reversed stage repetitions; each report alternates independent jsdom/rustdom process order; nine measured samples and three warmups per worker. Preserve 36 raw samples per engine, stage, node and workload row. Full public operation, bridge and result consumption are timed; setup, correctness checks, cleanup and GC are excluded.
budget.evaluation: Compare pooled sample medians against checkpoint 65 for every row separately. An over-budget row remains open for investigation and repeat measurement; aggregate wins do not cancel regressions. Record all results, including failed candidates. The budget is a regression target against the existing hybrid runtime, not a claim of superiority over jsdom.

methodology: Two reversed stage rounds per Node, each with the existing reversed engine order and three warmups plus nine measured samples per worker. Pool 36 raw samples per engine/stage/row. Evaluate every unadjusted candidate median against checkpoint65; wins do not offset over-budget rows. Keep per-round direction and the independent jsdom timings visible.
